economic_mechanism: A Binance Launchpool announcement that explicitly enables BNB staking/locking creates a new short-lived utility and opportunity-cost incentive to acquire or retain BNB before the farming window. The primary future mechanism test, if separately frozen after Source/Data PASS, will ask whether BNB outperforms BTC after the public announcement. No market-return outcome is authorized by this source authority.

source_contract.source_type: official Binance Support Launchpool announcement pages only
source_contract.reason_for_bounds: Official page confirms Launchpool #31 HFT was published 2022-10-31; official page confirms #63 BIO was published 2024-12-23. The bounded project-number sequence permits an auditable completeness gate without touching 2025/2026 announcements.
source_contract.event_inclusion: Official announcement explicitly identifies a Binance Launchpool project within project numbers 31 through 63 and explicitly offers BNB staking or locking in a supported pool.
source_contract.event_exclusion: Launchpad, HODLer Airdrops, Megadrop, listing-only announcements, or Launchpool projects with no explicit BNB pool.
source_contract.published_time_rule: Use the original 'Published on' timestamp shown by Binance, never a later 'Updated on' timestamp.
source_contract.simultaneous_announcements: Preserve every project as a source event; a later mechanism protocol must prospectively define timestamp clustering before any market outcomes are opened.

after_source_pass_only.required_next_step: Create a separate prospective mechanism-discovery freeze before opening any BNB or BTC market price field.
after_source_pass_only.candidate_primary_question_not_yet_autho: Does BNB/BTC have positive post-announcement return after BNB-enabled Launchpool announcements?
